name: SPT-CL J0339-4545 (Webb)
blurb: SPT-CL J0339-4545, a massive galaxy cluster, seen by Webb.
label: sptclj03394545-webb
story: A massive cluster of galaxies found by the South Pole Telescope's Sunyaev-Zel'dovich survey. Webb's SLICE program studies clusters like this one to track how both their luminous and dark components evolve.

claims.text: SPT-CL J0339-4545 is a galaxy cluster in the sample of massive clusters studied with Hubble weak lensing
The sample are massive galaxy clusters from the South Pole Telescope Sunyaev-Zel'dovich (SPT-SZ) Survey
The SLICE JWST program is designed to track the evolution of the luminous and dark components of galaxy clusters
